decisions.why: the division's own landing page (penlon.com/product-category/patient-monitors/) describes it as multi-parameter vital-signs monitors for a wide variety of clinical situations (V9: pulse oximetry, blood pressure, temperature, EtCO2; V6: SpO2, NIBP and CO2 for adult/paediatric/neonatal; AnyView S12/P18/P15: general clinical-area monitoring; BioVision: centralised monitoring of vital signs from multiple Penlon monitors) — general-purpose monitoring, not a single-purpose specialist device
